_readme.description: Synthetic Meditrail demo database with six patients and four doctor profiles.
_readme.important: All data is fictional and for UI/testing only. Doctor login profiles are demo identities; authentication must be implemented separately. Do not use for clinical decisions.
_readme.scope: Six patients, four doctors, patient-specific provider lists, representative documents, timeline events, medications, lab results, appointments, share grants/audit logs, and emergency cards.
_readme.note: The supplied UserProfile type models patients, not doctor login accounts. Provider represents a clinician contact, not an authenticated doctor account. Doctor login/authentication requires a separate auth/user-role model.
